{{Top|leg}}
'''Sparrows''' were small perching birds often preyed upon by [[Hawk (animal)/Legends|hawks]]. There was a common notion that [[God/Legends|God]] saw the death of each sparrow. One melodious-voiced species was the '''song sparrow'''.
